cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Efficiency Win
cards.instruction: Celebrate each inconvenience as proof that a faster, cheaper, or smarter routine can now be invented.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. The dishwasher's broken. Excellent: we'll serve the curry in rolls. No plates to wash.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: There are twelve guests and only six rolls.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Halve them. Open sandwiches: twice the servings, same bread.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Hollow them out first. Edible bowls, and the crumbs thicken the curry. We've saved the flour too.

mechanism: A grants successive serving revisions from above, celebrating each practical objection as another saving in the routine.
confusable: General optimism would call the meal fine; D44 requires actual proposed efficiencies in dishes, portions and ingredients.
comparison: Food-service redesign differs from replacing gym routines with stairs and shopping.
seedUse: Use D44-b broken dishwasher, bread quantity and runny curry; S01 approval should govern each specific efficiency revision.
